briefs.text: Cikande factory fire: 3 dead, 36 missing. (Guardian)
Leeds stun Chelsea 4–1 — first Bridge win since 1999 (Sky)
Arsenal 2–2 Newcastle after a late equaliser. (BBC)
Liverpool thrash Man Utd 4–0; Yoro sent off in 8th minute. (Sky)
England beat New Zealand 37–12. (Reuters)
France beat Argentina to reach the final. (Reuters)
BepiColombo enters Mercury orbit after 8 years. (AP)
Bolsonaro in intensive care, stable, breathing alone. (Reuters)
Estonia to shut its Russia border from 1 Dec. (Reuters)
Denmark expels a Russian attaché over a plot. (Guardian)
EU–Indonesia sign trade deal, Sat, after 10 years. (Reuters)
Costa proposes €1.78tn EU budget, cut ~€204bn. (Straits Times)
South Korea education minister resigns. (Presidential office)
Pope Leo lunches with 1,300 poor guests. (Vatican News)
El-Fasher's displaced face starvation, MSF warns. (MSF)
40 civilians killed in Cantine attack, Sat. (Local officials)
Somalia expels the UAE ambassador. (Reuters)
Nepal PM lands in Delhi on first state visit. (IANS)
30 Awami League homes set on fire. (TOI)
Amazon nears $7.5bn deal for AI startup Decart. (Crypto Briefing)
Trump threatens tax on data centres built abroad. (AP)
Marles rejects US report on AUKUS subs. (ABC)
